Class SpinOffCostDistribution

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.instrument.SpinOffCostDistribution
public final class SpinOffCostDistribution extends Object
Distributes the cost a spin-off moves from the parent over the parent's lots. Each part is proportional to the weight of its lot and the parts add up to the rounded total exactly, in minor units of the given precision. The minor units that rounding down leaves open go to the parts with the largest remainders, with the lot position as tie-break, so the result depends neither on which lot happens to be the last one nor on rounding errors that accumulate over many small lots.

A part never exceeds the cap of its lot, so a parent lot can not end up with a negative cost. A lot of weight 0 or less receives nothing.

  • Method Details

    • distribute

      public static double[] distribute(double total, double[] weights, double[] caps, int precision)
      Splits a total in proportion to the weights.
      Parameters:
      total - the amount to distribute, already rounded to precision
      weights - the basis of each part, typically the cost of each lot
      caps - the maximum of each part, aligned with weights; null for no maximum
      precision - the number of decimal places of the minor unit
      Returns:
      the parts, aligned with weights. They add up to total unless the caps can not hold it, which happens only when the caps carry fractions of the minor unit and the total is a few minor units; the parts then add up to less.

    • sum
